steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Alright, so why did you charge this place with those Archosauria again?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Well, I saw a village here, and I just thought it'd be fun to start a fight.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: ...I guess that's our Utage. Yer like a whole 'nother gal in a fight.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Aww, I'm sorry...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But how did you even manage to round up these guys without speaking their language?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Honestly, I don't really know.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Urgh, my nails are ruined. I'm so pissed.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: And just where the hell did my nail kit go? Now I'm twice as pissed.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: And I'm hella gross and sweaty after that fight. Plus, the air here is so humid, my clothes are totally soaked. Now I'm three times as pissed.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: And I'm, like, just walking around. Why do these Archosauria people keep coming up to me, picking fights? Now I'm four times as pissed.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: And I only tagged along 'cause I heard this would be a nice place for a vacation. This is totally not a vacation spot!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hmm? Is someone sneaking up on me? Are those... Archosauria?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Then I beat up all the sneaky dudes.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: And then some more of them came, so I beat all of them up.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: And somehow they all started to, like, worship me for some reason.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Oh, I see. They probably thought you were some kind of exotic animal. After all, no one from around here looks like you.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Huh?! Are you blind? How do you mistake a cutie like me for an animal?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Uh, well, to tell you the truth, you probably do look kinda like a freak to the Archosauria.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Also, I spotted the Great Wood Tribe's leader among your people, so I asked him. Apparently you're their leader now.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: I'm what?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Basically, you defeated the tribe's leader, and they're following you around because they look up to you as their leader now.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Huh? They don't even understand a word I'm saying! I thought they were just tagging along for fun!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: That's what happens when you're strong enough here.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: What should I do, Doctor...?

options: It's your mess. Figure it out yourself.
Might as well stick around and lead them.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Nnng... so mean!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Nng... Don't look at me like that, Doctor.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: I didn't mean to...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Eh? I don't wanna! Life without TV and AC? You might as well just kill me.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Whatever, we found you and Croissant. Now we just need to look for Blaze.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Blaze is probably fine. I can't imagine anything slowing her down.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Me neither. Oh, yeah, Baws, what's the plan now? We goin' to the Temple fer that ceremony Gavial was talkin' about?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, right, you two haven't heard yet. Doctor, why don't you tell them?
Explain the situation to Utage and Croissant.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Uh huh. Alrighty then, so we gon' be lookin' fer this Zumama to get yer engine back?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Eh? You mean the ceremony's over already?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Then what did I even come here for?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Whatever, it doesn't sound like something I'd care about anyway.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Also, Gavial, I thought you said this was a vacation spot!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? You don't think this place is great?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Well, actually, I guess, yeah, it's great!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: But, like, nothing here screams 'vacation!'

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What screams 'vacation' to you?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Like, beaches, oceans, parasols, and ice cream!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: I even got myself a new swimsuit! I've been wearing it underneath my outfit since before we left!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Eh, and here I tagged along just 'cause I got nothin' else to do...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Uh, I never said there's anything like that around here.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Didn't you say we were gonna play in the water?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Well yeah, that we can do. There's a huge waterfall deep in the rainforest.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: And since we're heading to Zumama's tribe, we'll pass by the waterfall for sure.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hell, I brought my swimsuit too. I just haven't taken it out yet.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Really? Awesome!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Well, it looks like you found who you're looking for.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah, Inam, thanks to you.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: No problem.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Oh I just remembered, where's Tomimi? I thought she was supposed to be with you guys.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: No idea. I think she had something else to take care of. We'll group up with her later.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Alright, bring her these books, then, will you?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What do we have here? 'City Beauty', 'Mastering Corporate Management in 100 Days', 'How to Become a Fashion Expert'...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: These are some weird titles!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: She's been learning Sargonian and what life in the outside world is like. After I taught her the basics, of course.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hm, I can't imagine these books help much with her Sargonian.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: You're right. But that's really how she learned it. Letter by letter, word by word.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: It may not be the best material to learn from, but it was more painful to see her not having a clue where to start.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: That's also why I decided to teach her Sargonian.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: You know, Gavial, she's really working hard to get to where you are.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: ...You don't need to tell me. I know.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: But well, I don't know that much about what it's like outside either. Besides, I can only bring so many books with me, so I don't really know whether she's learning anything useful from them, haha.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: ...No wonder there's always something weird about her.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hang on, don't tell me you're the one who taught Zumama Sargonian too.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Nope. I'm pretty curious about that myself. She did have me find her books on machinery, but it was like she just picked up Sargonian out of nowhere.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: And she's even teaching it to her tribe.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: ...Doctor, what do you think?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You think so too, huh?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You want me to think about it myself, huh?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm, alright. I'll settle this my way.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Since you're a new customer, I'll let you have it for 300 dinar.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: That's the look of a Doctor who just doesn't care.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Eh? T'ain't nothin' wrong with her teachin' Sargonian. If'n people here could talk with folks out there, they'd live a lot better.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Maybe. The way I think about it, compared to your supposedly much better lives, I think our way of life out here is satisfying enough.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I don't think you city folks would understand, though.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: That so...?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Oh, I think I get it! I mean, I lived in the countryside back in Higashi, too.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Eh? I took you for a city girl, what with how trendy you are.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Nope, this is just the kinda stuff I like.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: *Yawn*... I'm tired... time for a nap.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Here at our tribe, anything we leave out's for trade. If something catches your eye, have Gavial translate for you.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Hmm?

options: I've got a favor to ask you, too.
